snippet.title: SEBI 16 - Trailer
snippet.description:
SEBI 16 packs sixteen curated singleplayer games into one charming collection: metroidvanias, puzzle games, platformers, a roguelite, and even a deck builder. 

Built with love in PICO-8 ❤️
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946490/SEBI_16/
